artboards.title: Job record — the quote is the job

annotations.text: A · Quote Desk — the quote is the record. Mail-style list on the left, quote record on the right, activity always visible. Closest to Quotient. Tradeoff: no whole-pipeline picture at once.

B · Flow Board — the original status list as lanes in three phases (Quoting / Doing / Getting paid). Drag right to move on, drag down onto a truck-day to schedule. Tradeoff: needs a wide screen; phone becomes one lane at a time.

C · Today — an inbox of decisions, one button each. New leads, accepted quotes, questions, follow-ups, to-invoice. Everything else moves on its own. Tradeoff: relies on good rules for what shows up; the full pipeline is one tab away.

Shared by all three: the job record (price, status stepper, quote description, photos, activity — pre-quote details behind ⋯), the scheduler (trucks as rows, people as chips, leave greyed out, tray only holds Accepted work), and the two emails Josh and Ashley both receive.
